title: REPORT on the multiannual plan for the Baltic Sea and ways forward
part_text: Da. whereas the European eel (Anguilla anguilla) remains critically endangered; whereas its presence in the Baltic Sea has steadily decreased, implying an increased risk of extinction; whereas ICES continues to advise ‘zero catches’ for the European eel in all habitats; whereas ICES notes no or limited overall progress in achieving the objectives of the Eel Regulation1a; \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ 1a Council Regulation (EC) No 1100/2007 of 18 September 2007 establishing measures for the recovery of the stock of European eel (OJ L 248, 22.9.2007, p. 17, ELI:[http://data.europa.eu/eli/reg/2007/1100/oj](http://data.europa.eu/eli/reg/2007/1100/oj)).
